title: Where does my food go?
examples: Teacher, what happens to the food after my tummy?
Can you show me the path food takes in my body?
Is the mouth the first place food goes?

explain.say: When you eat, your food goes into your mouth first.
Now look. This is the digestive system in 3D. Can you see the oesophagus and the liver? Tap any part to hear about it.
Your teeth chew the food into tiny pieces.
Next, you swallow. The food goes down a tube to your tummy.
Your tummy mixes the food with juices. The juices help break it down.
Then the food goes into your long intestines. Your body takes in what it needs there.
Think about a banana. You chew it in your mouth. Then it goes to your tummy, and then your intestines.

faq.q: Where does the food go after my tummy?
faq.a: The food moves into the intestines next. The intestines take out the good energy for your body.
asks: Where does the food travel to next?

faq.q: Do I chew food in my mouth or my tummy?
faq.a: You chew the food in your mouth using your teeth. The tummy mixes it later on.
asks: Is chewing done in the stomach?

faq.q: What is the job of the intestines?
faq.a: The intestines are very long tubes. They take the good vitamins and energy from the food for you to grow.
asks: How do I get energy from food?

faq.q: Is the whole process fast or slow?
faq.a: It takes hours. Food can take a day or more to go all the way through.

faq.q: Do I need to chew all my food?
faq.a: Yes, chewing well in the mouth is very important. It helps the tummy work better later.
asks: Should I chew my food properly?

facts: Chewing in the mouth breaks food into small pieces.
The tummy mixes food with juices to help break it down.
The intestines absorb useful nutrients from the food.
This whole process is called digestion.

quiz.say: Where does your food go first?
quiz.why: Food goes into your mouth first. Your teeth chew it.

wrong.0: Your tummy comes after you chew and swallow.
wrong.1: Your intestines come last, after your tummy.

quiz.say: Which part mixes food with juices?
quiz.show: 🥣 Which part mixes food with juices?
quiz.why: Your tummy squeezes and mixes food with juices.

wrong.0: Your mouth chews the food first.
wrong.2: Your teeth chew the food into small pieces.

quiz.say: Where does your body take in what it needs from food?
quiz.show: 🍎 Where does your body take in nutrients?
quiz.why: Your long intestines take in nutrients from the food.

wrong.1: Your teeth chew food, and they take nothing in.
wrong.2: Your tummy mixes food first, then sends it on to the intestines.
